en-UK.name: Beilu Sysinfo
en-UK.description: System information monitoring — running processes, time, CPU/memory.
en-UK.description_markdown: **Beilu Sysinfo** allows the AI to query system status via `<sysinfo>` tags. Provides running processes, system time, CPU/memory usage, and OS information.
en-UK.author: 凛倾

zh-CN.name: 系统监控
zh-CN.description: 系统信息监控 — 运行程序、时间、CPU/内存
zh-CN.description_markdown: **系统监控** 允许 AI 通过 `<sysinfo>` 标签查询系统状态。提供运行程序列表、系统时间、CPU/内存使用率和操作系统信息。
zh-CN.author: 凛倾
